content.content: 1. Necessity per prerequisite: the marker needs the rendering clause for the no-document case it covers and the root-id rule for the id it names — without either, the marker is motiveless. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts either parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The root marker is where the no-document case meets the rendering clause and the root-id rule; the gate keeps the elaboration sound without testing the marker's form.
